machine.disk: File System Personality=APFS; Protocol=Apple Fabric; Solid State=Yes

dataset.name: Takei 2025 cerebellum rep 1, all FOVs (Zenodo 7693825)
dataset.subsetting: whole cells in a fixed random order (seed 0); above the real size, real cells copied under new cell/trace ids (flag 'replicated')

protocol.peak_rss: getrusage ru_maxrss of the read process (absolute; baseline = RSS after imports)

compression.h5cd 2.0: gzip-4 on integer / string data, floats uncompressed (cd.write default)
compression.chromdata.zarr 2.0: Parquet zstd-3 + Zarr zstd-3; spots sorted by (cell, trace, bin), 65,536-row row groups on cell boundaries (cd.write default)
compression.chromdata.zarr 2.1: Parquet zstd-3 + Zarr zstd-3; spot tables partitioned by chromosome (tables/spots/chrom=<name>/), sorted by (cell, trace, bin) within a partition, 16,384-row row groups on cell boundaries (cd.write default)
